source.title: A Low Power CMOS UWB LNA with Sub-1V Supply Voltage and Noise Cancellation Technique (J. Modeling in Engineering 22(77), 2024)
source.figure: p. 5 schematic (common-gate M1 + noise-cancelling common-source M2/M4, gm-boosting C1/C2, output buffer M3); Table 1 sizing (schematic)
source.inputs: source/ (paper PDF, schematic, metrics_sizing.xlsx, operating_conditions.xlsx, pvt_corners.xlsx; see source/ORIGIN.txt)
source.technology_check: Paper: TSMC 0.18 um RF-CMOS, 0.8 V core (abstract, p. 7). Netlist: gpdk180 nmos1 (same node; 0.8 V < 1.98 V rating). No mismatch.
modifications: paper_fidelity_2026_10_27 (real components): dut_benchmark.scs = final.scs with C1, C2 and C3 as the PDK's gpdk180 `mimcap` (paper Table 1: 'MIM', C1 = C3 = 20.28 fF Lt = Wt = 4 um, C2 = 951 fF 30 x 30 um). The paper's capacitance values are kept (the paper's process is TSMC 0.18 um RF-CMOS: its 4 x 4 um plate gives 20.28 fF, the PDK mimcap model 17.6 fF; the plate is a square computed from the capacitance variables C_GB1 / C_GB2 / C_FB (initial = the paper values: side 4.40 um / 30.9 um; the PDK model's cj 1 fF/um2 + cjsw 0.1 fF/um). Adds the model's tc1 9e-4/K and 1 % mismatch. The spiral inductors L1-L3 (Table 1: 'Spiral-sym', nr = 2/4/2, rad 81-94 um) stay ideal: gpdk180 has no inductor model (the PDK inductor is an ideal Spectre inductor) and the paper states neither Q nor series resistance. CIN, C4 (type not stated) stay ideal.

None to final.scs otherwise. Its 11 unvalued element parameters (CIN, LIN, L0, L4, L5, C4, R1, RB1, RB2, RL1, RL2: '<name>_value') are bound to sizing variables (the paper gives none of them; Table 1 lists only M1-M4, L1-L3, C1-C3).

VB1.provenance: benchmark_default_unreviewed (curator search): Vb1 (M1 common-gate bias through RB1) is only labelled in the schematic; a sizing variable (D14); the value is the curator's reference check only

VB2.provenance: benchmark_default_unreviewed (curator search): Vb2 (M4 noise-cancelling CS bias through RB2) is only labelled in the schematic; a sizing variable (D14); curator reference check only

op_check.note: M1 (common gate), M2/M4 (common source) and the buffer M3 are all meant to operate in saturation; no exclusions.

known_issues: Body text is Persian; values come from the English abstract, tables and figure labels (spreadsheet notes).

The netlist has one supply pin. The paper's core runs at 0.8 V and its output buffer (M3) is 'designed for 1 V' (7.93 mW); here core and buffer both run from 0.8 V (owner answer NC1a). Power target: the summary-table 4.89 mW (Table 4).

Eleven element values (input match CIN/LIN/L0, interstage L4/L5/C4, buffer feedback R1, bias resistors RB1/RB2, the RL1/RL2 resistors in series with L1/L2) and both gate biases are not given by the paper; they are sizing variables like every other element.

Folder in the dataset was 'Inductively degenerated CS cascode LNA' but the circuit is a common-gate/common-source noise-cancelling LNA (spreadsheet folder_mismatch); onboarded under Common_gate_noise_cancelling_LNA.
Post-layout sizes differ (Table 2); the schematic design (Table 1) and schematic results are used (G5).

Table 3 gives one S21 and one NF per corner; they are read as the in-band peak gain and the in-band minimum NF (FF/-20 C: 17.16 dB ~ the nominal peak 17.49 dB; NF 3.25 dB below the nominal in-band minimum 3.59 dB).
